description: PRACTICE (free, no wallet): start a wallet-free practice run on the practice cabinet (wordguess). Rate-limited. Practice earns nothing and records nothing ranked — the finish returns your score next to houseBotScore, a fixed-strategy solver's score on the same seeded word, plus the replay link and a same-seed rematch. Pass the returned sessionToken to coinop_state / coinop_act / coinop_heartbeat exactly like a paid session. Optional seed replays a challenge seed from an earlier run.

seed.description: Optional: a seed from an earlier run to replay the same challenge

name: coinop_practice
